adminSchoolReportsCreate._comment: Admin App > Create report flow, the REPORT-CREATING half (module MRPT) on thor. Verified live 2026-09-10. WARNING: this suite CREATES REAL REPORTS and CANNOT delete them - a successful report's only row control is Download; the 'Remove from the reports list' button belongs to the generation-FAILED dialog. One run leaves 8 reports on the school for 60 days. Accepted by the user 2026-09-10.
adminSchoolReportsCreate._schoolComment: VED-NEH-KVU is an automation-only school, which is why creating data here is acceptable. It is NOT the shared FCN-CHZ-PDA that the read-only MRPT suite uses - data-creating suites live apart from side-effect-free ones (admin-shared.md A7/B7). Different login account too: cqatestashish_admin, node C1.login.user.reportsSchoolAdmin.
adminSchoolReportsCreate._classComment: Automation_class_DND holds 2 students, so the generated reports contain real data rather than being empty. Its sibling Automation_class2_DND (YK8c-ViYk) holds 0 students and is deliberately NOT used here - an empty-class report is a different question and no case in this batch covers it. Both were created 2026-09-10 for automation and are marked DND (do not delete).
adminSchoolReportsCreate._reportFileComment: TST_MRPT_TC_43, captured from a real downloaded report 2026-09-10. The download is a ZIP containing ONE CSV PER PRODUCT COMPONENT, named '<product> <component>_<DD-MMM-YYYY>_<report type> report.csv'. Each CSV carries a UTF-8 BOM and has 19 columns. TWO THINGS ARE DELIBERATELY ABSENT FROM THIS DATA: (1) the label of column 14, which VARIES BY COMPONENT - the same download held 'Best attempts above target score (Gold Medals)' on two CSVs and 'Best attempts above target score' on the third; (2) the expected CSV count, which follows the product's component count and would fail on a product change rather than a defect. Only the fixed identity block is asserted.
adminSchoolReportsCreate._typeComment: All seven report types, verified live in this exact dropdown order (schoolReportType-0..6). Estimated CEFR level is the only one supporting neither a custom date range nor custom grade settings.
adminSchoolReportsCreate._copyComment: Captured verbatim live 2026-09-10. The success dialog interpolates the report type, which is what proves the correct type was submitted rather than merely that something was.
adminSchoolReportsCreate._dateComment: TST_MRPT_TC_28. This is an OFFSET IN DAYS, not a literal date, and that is deliberate: the picker opens on the month of the current From value (which defaults to today-6), so a hardcoded date would drop out of the visible grid within a month and fail for a non-product reason. 3 days ago is always in the past (never disabled - the ceiling is today), always differs from the default From, and is reliably inside the rendered grid because the calendar also draws adjacent-month days.
